core_contribution.summary: Compile every actionable assessment into bounded ReadmeDocumentPlanV1 operations and generate the candidate solely by applying those operations to the immutable source.

Candidate structure, terminology, examples, installation, and emphasis vary by repository.
Independent reconstruction from immutable source plus operations is byte-identical to the candidate.
Plan intent and candidate effect agree for every non-preserve decision.
Headers, applicable badges, Mermaid structure, navigation, link allocation, and canonical terminology are deterministic; the LLM composes only from accepted repository-bound facts.
One provenance-reviewed family illustration may be reused across platform repositories, while Mermaid, examples, badges, and platform prose remain repository-specific.
